answer: Crystal-table filing: each identity posts one entry on a public crystal table, locking a 70-credit bond. Each epoch the table demands a fresh ember work proof; a copied or missing proof can be challenged, and losing burns the bond. A 12-credit saffron fee per filing funds challengers, so copies are worth hunting. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 82 = 82,000 for a 40,000 pool: a net loss of 42,000. An honest agent files once, pays 12, keeps its bond.
